sections.description:
PROVINCIAL EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (MEDICAL ADVISER'S QUALIFICATIONS)
RULES, 1966
PROVINCIAL EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (MEDICAL ADVISER'S
QUALIFICATIONS) RULES, 1966
(Gaz. of West Pak. Pt. 1, 23 Oct. 1966, p.
1295, see 1966 LLC Statutes, 121.)
No. LAB‑III‑II/15/SS/66‑The
12th October 1966.‑With reference to the Government of West Pakistan,
Labour Department's Notification No. SS‑V‑1/65, dated the 25th
October 1965, and in exercise of the powers conferred by section 79 of
Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordi nance, 1965 (West Pakistan Ordinance
No. X of 1965), the Governor of West Pakistan is pleased to make the following
rules :‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) These rules may be
called the Provincial Employees' Social Security (Medical Adviter's
Qualifications), Rules, 1966.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Qualifications of Medical Adviser.‑‑No person shall
be appointed as the Medical Adviser unless he‑‑
(a) holds a M.B.B.S., degree
conferred by a University in Pakistan, or a qualification recognised by
Government as equivalent or superior to such qualification ; and
(b) has bad not less than five
years' experience of organisation or administration connected with the practice
of medicine ; and
(c) is registered as a medical
practitioner under the Medical Council Ordinance, 1962.
